[[Image:Asura Commoner m.jpg|250px]] | affiliation = Asura | type = Asura | level = 20 | campaign = Eye of the North }} [[Big Machine Krewe Member]]s are [[Asura]] who offer the [[Asuran Bodyguard]] [[blessing]]. They can be found next to [[resurrection shrine]]s. ==Locations== * [[Tarnished Coast]] ** {{NPC location|Arbor Bay}} ** {{NPC location|Trial of Zinn}} ==Dialogue== ===Not under [[Asuran Bodyguard]]=== : ''"We're trying to make a machine. It's going to be big. BIG! We're going to have to clear the whole area! To start with, we'll need all the creatures eradicated. Do you think you're up to the task, bookah? Here's a little bit of Asuran technology to help you out if you take the job."'' {{offer dialog |accept = I'll get right on that whole clearing the area thing. |decline = Can't these machines of yours ever be compact? |accepticon = [[File:Asuran Bodyguard.jpg|20px]] |ask = And after the area's clear, we put down rock over it all and build a giant bazaar where everyone can trade all day long! Hahah! }} ===Under Veteran Asuran Bodyguard=== ;One of the following :''"And after the area's clear, we put down a rock over it all and then build a giant bazaar where everyone can trade all day long! It'll be amazing!"'' :''"The mountains aren't the hard part. It's the speedbumps I'm worried about. Every time we build them, we end up losing half the krewe..."'' ===During Trial of Zinn=== ;Before the trial :''"Nice to take a break from working on the Big Machine. The tough thing about living on the surface these days is that there aren’t all those Dwarves and Dredge to trick into doing all our manual labor."'' ;After the trial :''"An amusing way to pass an afternoon, but I'd take a good explosion over this any day. Atleast an explosion is unpredictable."'' [[Category:Offers Eye of the North bounty-like blessing]]
